activeElement._instruction: If applicable, list the identifiers of the active coil elements or channels.

signalDirectionality._instruction: Add the functional role of the coil. Examples include 'transmit-only', 'receive-only', 'transmit/receive'(bidirectional).

mountingLocation._instruction: Add the position of the coil relative to the subject's anatomy (e.g., head, knee, body).

targetAnatomyCoverage._instruction: Add the anatomical region(s) the coil is designed to cover.
